script = '''import fitz  # PyMuPDF
from docx import Document

def docx_to_pdf(docx_path, pdf_path):
    doc = Document(docx_path)

    pdf = fitz.open()  # new empty PDF

    # Page settings
    page_width = 595.28   # A4 width in points
    page_height = 841.89  # A4 height in points
    margin_left = 72
    margin_right = 72
    margin_top = 72
    margin_bottom = 72
    usable_width = page_width - margin_left - margin_right

    # Font settings
    font_sizes = {
        "title": 18,
        "subtitle": 14,
        "heading": 14,
        "normal": 11,
    }
    line_spacing_factor = 1.4

    page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
    y = margin_top

    def new_page():
        nonlocal page, y
        page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
        y = margin_top

    for para in doc.paragraphs:
        text = para.text.strip()
        if not text:
            y += 6  # blank line spacing
            if y > page_height - margin_bottom:
                new_page()
            continue

        # Determine style
        style_name = (para.style.name or "").lower()
        if "title" in style_name:
            font_size = font_sizes["title"]
            bold = True
        elif "subtitle" in style_name:
            font_size = font_sizes["subtitle"]
            bold = True
        elif "heading" in style_name:
            font_size = font_sizes["heading"]
            bold = True
        else:
            font_size = font_sizes["normal"]
            bold = any(run.bold for run in para.runs) if para.runs else False

        line_height = font_size * line_spacing_factor
        fontname = "helv" if not bold else "hebo"

        # Word-wrap: split text into lines that fit usable_width
        words = text.split()
        lines = []
        current_line = ""
        for word in words:
            test_line = (current_line + " " + word).strip()
            tw = fitz.get_text_length(test_line, fontname=fontname, fontsize=font_size)
            if tw <= usable_width:
                current_line = test_line
            else:
                if current_line:
                    lines.append(current_line)
                current_line = word
        if current_line:
            lines.append(current_line)

        for line in lines:
            if y + line_height > page_height - margin_bottom:
                new_page()
            page.insert_text(
                fitz.Point(margin_left, y + font_size),
                line,
                fontname=fontname,
                fontsize=font_size,
            )
            y += line_height

        y += 4  # paragraph spacing

    # Also handle tables
    for table in doc.tables:
        for row in table.rows:
            row_text = " | ".join(cell.text.strip() for cell in row.cells)
            if not row_text.strip():
                continue
            font_size = 10
            line_height = font_size * line_spacing_factor
            fontname = "helv"

            words = row_text.split()
            lines = []
            current_line = ""
            for word in words:
                test_line = (current_line + " " + word).strip()
                tw = fitz.get_text_length(test_line, fontname=fontname, fontsize=font_size)
                if tw <= usable_width:
                    current_line = test_line
                else:
                    if current_line:
                        lines.append(current_line)
                    current_line = word
            if current_line:
                lines.append(current_line)

            for line in lines:
                if y + line_height > page_height - margin_bottom:
                    new_page()
                page.insert_text(
                    fitz.Point(margin_left, y + font_size),
                    line,
                    fontname=fontname,
                    fontsize=font_size,
                )
                y += line_height
            y += 2

    pdf.save(pdf_path)
    pdf.close()
    print(f"OBSERVATION: Successfully converted to {pdf_path}")

docx_to_pdf("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx", "/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''
